display_text: Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver) ** Adds [[Bone Breaking]][[Bone Breaking]]: Critical hits by this weapon deal an extra 1 to 6 points of Dexterity damage by shattering the bones of its target.[[Category:Bone Breaking items]] ** Adds [[Spikes]][[Spikes]]: The sharp spikes on this item deal an additional 1 to 6 Piercing damage when used to strike an enemy.[[Category:Spikes items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
raw_html: [[Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver)]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]][[Upgradeable Item (Stormreaver)]]: This item could be upgraded if you found a [[Item:Seal of the Stormreaver|Seal of the Stormreaver]] to combine it with. Bring this item to the [[Stormreaver Monument]] in [[Gianthold]] and combine it with a Seal of the Stormreaver to upgrade the item to a more powerful form. ** Adds [[Bone Breaking]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Bone Breaking]]:''' Critical hits by this weapon deal an extra 1 to 6 points of Dexterity damage by shattering the bones of its target.[[Category:Bone Breaking items]] ** Adds [[Spikes]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Spikes]]:''' The sharp spikes on this item deal an additional 1 to 6 Piercing damage when used to strike an enemy.[[Category:Spikes items]][[Category:Upgradeable items]]
